title: block-circulant Mirror
hypothesis: A single shared block-circulant kernel bank plus compact per-role block-shift addresses can reproduce four role-specific linear functions generated from the same operator, at lower serialized bytes than both independent block-circulant adapters and untied dense matrices.
physical_object: One 4x4 bank of 4x4 circulant blocks, represented by 64 real kernel values plus one shared 16D bias
mirror_coordinate: A per-role 4x4 table of circular shifts in {0,1,2,3}, serialized as charged int8 indices
logical_multiplicity: Four role-conditioned 16x16 linear maps assembled from one physical block-circulant kernel bank
targeted_literature: Block Circulant Adapter for Large Language Models (arXiv:2505.00582)
Differentiable Learning of Generalized Structured Matrices for Efficient Deep Neural Networks (arXiv:2310.18882)
Compact Circulant Layers with Spectral Priors (arXiv:2602.21965)
Practical Lessons on Vector-Symbolic Architectures in Deep Learning-Inspired Environments (Carzaniga et al., 2025; PA11)
controls: shared block-circulant plus fixed HRR address
shared block-circulant plus learned Givens address
shared dense matrix plus per-role rank-1 residual
teacher: Aligned condition samples one 4x4 block bank of length-4 circulant kernels and creates each role by rolling each block kernel by a role-specific fixed offset. Independent condition samples arbitrary dense role matrices. The candidate receives the same charged shift table used by the aligned teacher; MAP, Hadamard and HRR addresses use distinct fixed operators.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across all methods and both conditions; select one common rate before fresh access

storage.authority: actual serialized torch.save inference payload bytes
paid_objects: learned Givens angles or low-rank residual factors

success_gate: In all three fresh aligned worlds, block-shift Mirror MSE <=1.10x untied and serialized bytes <=0.65x untied. Also report comparison with independent block-circulant adapters, MAP, Hadamard and low-rank controls. This is a fixed-update aligned-mechanism gate, not capacity evidence.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss the 1.10x untied-quality or 0.65x-byte gate. Keep fresh worlds sealed after failure.
boundaries: Teacher intentionally generated by block-circulant kernel shifts
Fixed 1200-update screen, not near-convergence or fixed-byte capacity frontier
No language-model or broad structured-matrix superiority claim
Dense eager materialization is used for inference timing; MAC proxy describes FFT block-circulant operations
